results.title: Weak Critics Make Strong Learners: On-Policy Critique Distillation for Scalable Oversight
results.snippet: As large language models become stronger, weak supervisors may fail to provide reliable labels, preferences, or final judgments for complex outputs, limiting both weak-to-strong generalization and scalable oversight. We study a more tractable form of weak supervision: using a weak model as a critic rather than as a labeler or judge. results.title: Knowledge Divergence and the Value of Debate for Scalable Oversight
results.snippet: AI safety via debate and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) are both proposed methods for scalable oversight of advanced AI systems, yet no formal framework relates them or characterizes when debate offers an advantage. We analyze this by parameterizing debate's value through the geometry of knowledge divergence between debating models. Using principal angles between models' representation subspaces, we prove that the debate advantage admits an exact closed form. findings.point: 可扩展监督中出现了新的弱监督设定「weak-critic strong oversight」：弱模型不充当标注者、偏好标注者或最终裁判，而只提供「非误导性的修改方向」，以帮助强模型更好利用自身已有知识。

# 价值对齐与可扩展监督（含校准与不确定性）：七维增量追踪报告

**报告日期**：2026-10-14（UTC）
**领域**：AI 价值对齐 / 可扩展监督（Scalable Oversight）/ 校准与不确定性量化（Calibration & UQ）
**检索源数量**：32 条候选来源（[1]–[32]），其中与本主题直接相关的约 15 条
**方法论**：`frontier-watch` 七维增量骨架 + `evidence-grading` 四轴证据 + `deep-research` 交叉验证纪律
**证据基础声明（重要）**：本报告**只**基于给定候选块内容撰写。候选块中大量条目仅有标题与元数据，正文/实验数字/引用数不可得，凡此类情况一律标注 `> 待核实`。本次检索候选中存在**明显主题污染**（[6][11][13][15][22][24] 等为天体物理、超分辨率、短视频、灵巧手等无关领域；[26][27][28][29][30][31] 为 GitHub 工程学研究），本报告将这些条目仅作为**检索质量问题**的旁证，不作为主题论据。

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）
